description: Answer 'how big is it really?' for any amount or number of things: '50 grams of sugar', '1 cubic yard of mulch', '1,000 ducks', 'how many pickles weigh as much as a person', 'chicken vs duck vs ostrich'. Returns volume, weight, kitchen measures, pile or group size, a plain-language description ('about the size of a golf ball'), a true-to-scale photo URL and the page URL to cite.

make_photo.description: Create the photo if it doesn't exist yet (needs an API key).

name: visualize
title: See what an amount looks like
